How long the payload can produce no output before the app treats it as stalled. Some payloads intentionally stay quiet, so a short limit can stop a healthy run. The default matches the whole-run limit, and fresh-session profiles ignore it.

The payload profile decides how many attempts it gets, how long each may take, and how it looks for the slide. Leave the override off unless you are testing a device the profile was not written for.

Uses the app\'s numbers for attempts, per-attempt timeout, and slide route instead of the profile\'s. Useful for testing a build the feed does not support yet, and it can make a working target fail.
